Name: SNOMEDCTBodyStructures

Name: BundleType
Title: BundleType
Description: Indicates the purpose of a bundle - how it is intended to be used.

Name: CommonTags
Title: Common Tags
Description: Common Tag Codes defined by FHIR project

Name: Condition/Problem/DiagnosisCodes

Title: IdentifierType

Name: IdentifierUse
Title: IdentifierUse

Title: RequestStatus
Description: Codes identifying the lifecycle stage of a request.

Title: ResponseType
